# `aitbc transactions pending`

Get the list of pending transactions from the node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc transactions pending [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc transactions pending
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc transactions pending --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
